lines.zh: 我走得很直，像有人在看。
lines.en: I walk very straight, as if being watched.

lines.zh: 我的步子有点长，不太对。
lines.en: My stride is a little too long. Not quite right.
I walk along the cabin's wall.

lines.zh: 我停在窗前，然后继续走。
lines.en: I stop at the window, then walk on.

lines.zh: 我走过院子，身后没有脚印。
lines.en: I cross the yard and leave no footprints behind.

lines.zh: 我每走一段，就调整一次脸。
lines.en: Every so often I adjust my face.
I walk on the grass, and it does not bend.
I walk toward that door.
My head turns before my body does.
I am in no hurry. I have plenty of time.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但一直没停。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 我从树后面出来，又进去。
lines.en: I step out from behind a tree, then back in.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，数着木板。
lines.en: I walk the fence, counting the planks.
My feet make no sound.
I go around to the back of the house.

lines.zh: 我在门口站住，看着门缝。
lines.en: I stop at the door and look at the gap.
I stand with my face toward the window.

lines.zh: 我的嘴动了一下，没出声。
lines.en: My mouth moves once, silently.
I have been still for a long time.
Locking the door won't help you.
I am learning how you walk.
My eyes are not quite in the right place.
I hear someone turn over inside.

lines.zh: 我站在窗边，胸口一动不动。
lines.en: I stand by the window, my chest perfectly still.
My fingers are longer than before.

lines.zh: 我在门缝边站了一整夜。
lines.en: I stood by the door gap all night.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，脖子响了一下。
lines.en: I tilt my head; my neck clicks.
I want to come in, but the door is shut.
I count the footsteps inside.

lines.zh: 我把自己摆得更像一个站着的人。
lines.en: I arrange myself to look more like a standing person.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上不太对。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall is wrong.
I smile. It is too wide.
You opened the door. Good.
We look alike, do we not?
I learn your way of speaking quickly.
Do not back away; we are not finished.
My home is near too. Very near.

lines.zh: 你屋里只有你一个人吗。
lines.en: Are you alone in that house?

lines.zh: 我一直站在这里，等你看见我。
lines.en: I have stood here waiting for you to notice.

lines.zh: 你的声音很好听，我想学。
lines.en: Your voice is pleasant. I want to learn it.

lines.zh: 我抬手的样子，像不像你。
lines.en: Does my raised hand look like yours?
Closing the door will not help. I am still here.
You struck me. I am still here.
That was almost useless against me.

lines.zh: 我的脸歪了一点，我掰回来。
lines.en: My face went crooked. I set it back.
I do not bleed.

lines.zh: 刀口合上了，我重新站直。
lines.en: The cut closes; I straighten up again.

lines.zh: 你能感觉到手感不对吧。
lines.en: You felt that the impact was wrong, did you not.
My body has no pain.
The more you strike, the more I resemble you.
I need not attend to that wound.
Only fire can truly destroy me.

lines.zh: 你把面包递来，我只看着你的手。
lines.en: You offer bread; I only watch your hand.

lines.zh: 你把食物留给屋里的人吧。
lines.en: Save the food for whoever is inside.
I have no stomach, only a shape.

lines.zh: 这东西我咬不动，也不需要。
lines.en: I cannot bite it and do not need it.
Set the plate down and let me look.
I would rather you opened the door.
Holding it up, you look very human.
I am not hungry. I only want to come in.
Do not let your hand shake; I learn slowly.
Go ahead and eat. I will wait here.
That is not what I like.

lines.zh: 你以为喂饱我就没事了。
lines.en: You think feeding me settles it.
I am still outside your door.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，退后三步。
lines.en: Put it down and step back three paces.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我一点没动。
lines.en: You bumped into me. I did not move at all.

lines.zh: 我们皮肤贴着皮肤，太近了。
lines.en: Our skin touched. Too close.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，我还站着。
lines.en: When you pulled away, I was still standing.
Hitting me makes no sound.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我顺势靠近了。
lines.en: You bumped in, and I leaned closer.

lines.zh: 我还站在原地，位置没变。
lines.en: I am still in the same spot.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我还在门边。
lines.en: You took three steps back. I am still by the door.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我的脸会让你记一辈子。
lines.en: Not so close, my face will stay with you for life.

lines.zh: 我有形状，没有那种东西。
lines.en: I have a shape, not such things.
You ask as if speaking to a person.
I have imitated many things.
That is not what I need.
I only need a door.
Is the one inside asking too?
Do not speak at my ear.

lines.zh: 我没有同类，只有更多同类。
lines.en: I have no kin — only more of my kind.
I could learn it, but it is useless.
I pick this up.
Blades don't cut me — only fire.
I lift it and look a long time.
This is yours. I know.
I place it at the door.
I use it to practise having hands.
It falls, without a sound.
I hold it and wait for you to come looking.

lines.zh: 烧不死的我，你终于看清了。
lines.en: Unburnable me — you finally see it.
This step is longer than the last.
I have set my face properly.
The door is behind you.

lines.zh: 你举起火把，我反而走近一步。
lines.en: You raise a torch; I step closer instead.
Call out — no one will answer.

lines.zh: 门没锁，我就自己进来找你了。
lines.en: The door wasn't locked, so I let myself in to find you.

lines.zh: 你听见我的声音了吗？那就别回头。
lines.en: You heard my voice, didn't you? Then don't look back.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是从你那儿拿的。
lines.en: This face of mine came from yours.
Wherever you go, I am behind.

lines.zh: 我贴着篱笆走，木板一块也没响。
lines.en: I move along the fence and not one board creaks.
Look back and I am there.

lines.zh: 我学你的步子，学得很像。
lines.en: I copy your stride. Very like.
You go in; I am at the window.

lines.zh: 你的影子旁边还有一条。
lines.en: There is another shadow beside yours.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就贴在门后的暗处。
lines.en: You look back, and I am pressed into the dark behind the door.

lines.zh: 你锁门的声音我听见了。
lines.en: I heard you lock the door.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但你会记住。
lines.en: This is not heavy, but you will remember it.

lines.zh: 我抓了一下，皮肤滑开了。
lines.en: I grab; the skin slides away.
My arm is longer than before.
Do not struggle; you will hurt yourself.
I push, and you retreat.

lines.zh: 我贴得很近，你看不清我。
lines.en: I am so close you cannot see me clearly.
My fingers press into the doorframe.
After that blow, you are still standing.

lines.zh: 我站在院子边上，像一直在这儿。
lines.en: I stand at the yard's edge, as if always here.
My face has no expression yet.

lines.zh: 我学着把两条腿分开站。
lines.en: I learn to stand with my legs apart.

lines.zh: 这具身体是从别处借来的。
lines.en: This body is borrowed from somewhere.
I see light in the window.
A figure moves inside.
I begin imitating that figure.

lines.zh: 我的脖子转了半圈才正过来。
lines.en: My neck turned half a circle to face front.

lines.zh: 门口有一块石头，我绕过去。
lines.en: A stone at the door; I step around it.
I remember what to do.

lines.zh: 火一碰我，这具身体开始塌。
lines.en: Fire touches me and this body begins to collapse.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶落下，身体却没摔坏。
lines.en: I fall from the roof and the body does not break.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里，不挣扎也不沉。
lines.en: I lie in water, neither struggling nor sinking.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀开，我又站直了。
lines.en: The blast throws me aside; I straighten up again.

lines.zh: 箭穿过了我，留下一个不流血的洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through, leaving a bloodless hole.

lines.zh: 咒力打在我身上，只是让轮廓晃了晃。
lines.en: The curse hits and only makes my outline waver.
I do not eat, so I cannot starve.

lines.zh: 雷打穿我，我的形状散了一下。
lines.en: Lightning passes through and my shape loosens.

lines.zh: 我掉进空里，还在看着你。
lines.en: I fall into nothing, still watching you.
